title: Nashville’s Ideal location 7Bed/3Bath in NEW house
description:
Enjoy this sylish new build! Experience everything Nashville has to offer, walkable or short Uber to Nissan stadium, Broadway/Preds games, the Gulch, local eateries, and Top Golf.
 Sleeps 12- Greenway & playground across the street- Starbucks, DD, chipotle and convenience store within walking distance. Designated of street parking, security cameras. Pet friendly - kid friendly - Business travel. Fully stocked with all toiletries, paper products, kitchenware, wash and dryer, and fresh linens!

The space
First floor- Queen bed and full bathroom . 

Second floor. Master bedroom with twin bunk beds and end suite full bathroom. 

Second and third bedroom with queen bed each. 3rd full bathroom at end of the hall.

Other things to note
Salemtown is a lively residential neighborhood of over 500 homes located 1.5 miles north of Broadway in downtown Nashville.  On a Saturday morning, you may find our residents running with their dogs, strolling with their children to grab a coffee, or walking to area restaurants to grab a bite to eat. The nightlife makes for a perfect place to host bachelor/bachelorette  parties, football events, and much more!
